subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the appropriate article.
______ famous poem 'Ode to a Nightingale' by ______ Romantic poet John Keats.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 1**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 

• The article "**The**" is used with specific or well-known nouns. In this context, "**The famous poem**" refers to a specific, well-recognized poem. 

• The article "**the**" is also used before "**Romantic poet John Keats**" because it specifies a particular poet within the Romantic era.
